model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the log loss over the number of iterations for several machine learning models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," represents the number of iterations, displayed on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120000, with tick intervals of 10000. The y-axis, labeled “L”, displays log loss values ranging from approximately 2.3 to 3.4, with tick intervals of 0.1. A purple line, labeled “Vanilla,” begins at a value of approximately 2.9 and gradually declines to a value of approximately 2.6 over the course of the iterations. A red line, labeled “StrmLLM (n=64),” starts at approximately 3.1 and decreases to approximately 2.8 over the iterations. A green line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64),” commences at approximately 2.7 and decreases to approximately 2.4. Finally, a maroon line, labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T),” begins at approximately 2.9 and decreases to approximately 2.5 over the iterations.
